title: Display non-printable characters and whitespace in a file
summary: Use `cat` with specific flags to reveal hidden characters like tabs and line endings. This helps debug formatting issues in text files.

steps.explain: Use the `-v`, `-t`, and `-e` flags together to display non-printable characters, tabs (as `^I`), and line endings (as `$`).

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to inspect.
